blocks.text: there va it: yangi narsa va ma'lum narsa

there is / there are, there was / there will be va ob-havo, vaqt, masofa bilan **it** qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 37–39-darslar). Asosiy mantiq bitta: **there** gapga **yangi** narsani kiritadi — o'zbekcha «... **bor**», «... **yo'q**», «... **bo'ladi**»; **it** esa allaqachon tilga olingan, **ma'lum** narsaga ishora qiladi yoki butun **vaziyatni** bildiruvchi bo'sh ega bo'ladi: It's late, It's a pity. O'zbekchada bunday gaplarda ega umuman bo'lmaydi («Bor», «Kech bo'ldi», «Afsus»), shuning uchun «Is a problem», «There is difficult» kabi xatolar ko'p uchraydi. Bu darsda there ning murakkab shakllari (**there must be**, **there's bound to be**) va it ning vaziyat ma'nolari (**it's no use**, **it's a pity**) ko'riladi.

rows: **There's** a new café near the station.
**There was** a strange noise in the night.

items.text: **There's** a new Korean restaurant on Navoi Street. — I know, **it's** excellent.
items.translation: Navoiy ko'chasida yangi koreys restorani **ochilibdi**. — Bilaman, **u** juda zo'r.

items.text: **There was** a parcel outside the door, but **it** wasn't for us.
items.translation: Eshik oldida bir posilka **bor edi**, lekin **u** bizga emas ekan.

items.text: **Is there** a lift in this building? — Yes, but **it's** out of order.
items.translation: Bu binoda lift **bormi**? — Ha, lekin **u** ishlamayapti.

blocks.text: there + modal fe'llar: there must be, there might be

there istalgan fe'l shakli bilan kela oladi, ayniqsa **there + modal + be**: there **will** be (bo'ladi), there **must** be (aniq bor — xulosa), there **might / may / could** be (bo'lishi mumkin), there **should** be (bo'lishi kerak, kutiladi), there **can't** be (bo'lishi mumkin emas), there **used to** be (ilgari bor edi). O'tgan zamon haqida xulosa — there **must have been**, there **might have been**, there **should have been** (modal fe'llar → 28–33-darslar). Fe'lning soni there ga emas, keyingi otga qarab tanlanadi: There **is** a mistake — There **are** some mistakes.

rows: **There will be** a meeting at ten.
**There must be** a mistake in the bill.
**There might be** traffic on the bridge.
**There should be** a pharmacy near the hotel.
**There can't be** two people with the same passport number.
**There used to be** a cinema here.

items.text: The lights are on, so **there must be** someone at home.
items.translation: Chiroqlar yoniq, demak, uyda kimdir **bor bo'lsa kerak**.

items.text: **There might be** a strike at the airport next week.
items.translation: Kelasi hafta aeroportda ish tashlash **bo'lishi mumkin**.

items.text: **There used to be** a cinema here, but now it's a shopping centre.
items.translation: Bu yerda **ilgari** kinoteatr **bor edi**, hozir esa savdo markazi.

blocks.text: there's bound to be, there seems to be, there's no need

**there is bound / sure / certain to be** — «albatta ... bo'ladi», «... bo'lmay qolmaydi»: There's bound to be a queue at the bank on Monday. **there is likely / unlikely to be** — «... bo'lishi ehtimoli katta / dargumon». **there seems / appears to be** — «... borga o'xshaydi». Inkor qoliplar: **there's no need to** ... — «... ga hojat yo'q»; **there's no point in -ing** — «...dan foyda yo'q» (→ 63-dars); **there's nowhere to** ..., **there's nothing to** ... Taqqoslang: **It's** likely **that** prices will rise — **There are** likely **to be** price rises: ma'no bir xil, tuzilish boshqa.

items.text: Don't worry, **there's bound to be** a cash machine at the station.
**There seems to be** a problem with your booking.
**There's no need to** shout — I can hear you perfectly.
items.translation: Baqirishga **hojat yo'q** — sizni juda yaxshi eshityapman.

blocks.text: it: vaziyat haqida — it's a pity, it's no use

**it** gapning bo'sh egasi bo'lib, butun vaziyatni bildiradi: **It's** a long way to the airport. **It** takes two hours to get there. **It's** a pity (that) you can't come. **It's** no use / no good complaining (foydasi yo'q, → 63-dars). **It's** worth visiting. **It** surprised me that he didn't call. Infinitiv yoki that-gap oldida ham faqat it: **It's** difficult **to find** a flat here («There is difficult» emas!), I **find it** hard to concentrate, **It's** time to go (→ 35-dars). Sifat yoki baho bo'lsa — it; mavjudlik («bor / yo'q») bo'lsa — there.

rows: **It's** a long way to the station.
**There's** a long queue at the station.
**It's** a pity you missed the party.

items.text: **It's a pity** that Emma couldn't come to the wedding.
**It's no use** calling him — his phone is always switched off.
items.translation: Unga qo'ng'iroq qilishdan **foyda yo'q** — telefoni doim o'chiq.

items.text: **It's** a long way to the airport, so let's leave early.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Is a problem with my visa» → **There's a problem** with my visa; «In my city has a big park» → **There's a big park** in my city (yoki My city **has** a big park); «There is difficult to find a job» → **It's difficult** to find a job; «Is very cold today» → **It's very cold** today; «It has many people in the bazaar» → **There are a lot of people** in the bazaar; «There must to be» → **There must be**; «It's no use to complain» → **It's no use complaining**; «It will be a meeting tomorrow» → **There will be a meeting** tomorrow.

O'zbekcha gapga qarang. «... **bor** / **yo'q** / **bo'ladi** / **chiqadi**» — yangi narsa paydo bo'lyapti → **there**. «Qiyin», «afsus», «uzoq», «foydasi yo'q», «arziydi» — vaziyatga baho → **it**. Oldin tilga olingan narsa haqida gapni davom ettirsangiz → **it** (ko'plikda — **they**).

rows: it + sifat + to / that: **It's** hard to ...
there's **no need to**, there's **no point in** -ing
there **used to** be, there **seems to** be
**It** surprised me that ..., I **find it** hard to ...

examples.title: **There's** a new café — **it's** great
examples.description: there yangi narsani kiritadi («... bor»), it esa allaqachon tilga olingan narsaga ishora qiladi.

sentences.text: On our street **there's** a new bakery, and **it** sells the best samsa I've ever tasted.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizda yangi novvoyxona **ochilibdi**, **u yerda** men tatib ko'rgan eng mazali somsa sotiladi.

sentences.text: **There was** an interesting article in today's paper. Did you read **it**?
sentences.translation: Bugungi gazetada qiziq bir maqola **bor edi**. **Uni** o'qidingizmi?

sentences.text: Listen, **there's** someone at the door. — **It's** probably the courier with my parcel.
sentences.translation: Quloq sol, eshik oldida **kimdir bor**. — **Bu**, ehtimol, posilkamni olib kelgan kuryerdir.

sentences.text: **Is there** a chemist's anywhere near the hotel? — Yes, **it's** next to the bank on the corner.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona yaqinida biror dorixona **bormi**? — Ha, **u** burchakdagi bankning yonida.

sentences.text: When I checked my phone, **there were** two messages, and **they** were both from the bank.
sentences.translation: Telefonimni tekshirsam, ikkita xabar **bor ekan**, **ikkalasi** ham bankdan.

sentences.text: **There's** a problem with the heating — **it** keeps switching off at night.
sentences.translation: Isitishda muammo **bor** — **u** kechalari o'chib qolaveradi.

sentences.text: Behind the madrasa **there's** a little restaurant — **it** isn't in any guidebook, but **it's** wonderful.
sentences.translation: Madrasa orqasida kichkina restoran **bor** — **u** hech qaysi yo'lko'rsatkichda yo'q, lekin juda ajoyib.

sentences.text: Was **there** much traffic? — No, **it** was a very easy drive.
sentences.translation: Yo'lda tirbandlik **ko'pmidi**? — Yo'q, mashina haydash juda **oson bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Tonight **there's** a film about Ulugbek on TV. **It** starts at nine.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun televizorda Ulug'bek haqida film **bor**. **U** soat to'qqizda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: **There's** a long queue outside the museum, but **it's** moving quickly.
sentences.translation: Muzey oldida uzun navbat **bor**, lekin **u** tez siljiyapti.

examples.title: Modals: **there must be**, **there might be**
examples.description: there + modal + be: there must be (aniq, xulosa), there might / could be (ehtimol), there should be (kutilgan), there can't be (mumkin emas). O'tgan zamonda — there must have been.

sentences.text: The bill is far too high — **there must be** a mistake.
sentences.translation: Hisob juda baland — **xato bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Take an umbrella, because **there might be** showers later this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Soyabon olib ol, chunki tushdan keyin **yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: According to the map, **there should be** a petrol station after the next village.
sentences.translation: Xaritaga ko'ra, keyingi qishloqdan keyin yoqilg'i quyish shoxobchasi **bo'lishi kerak**.

sentences.text: **There can't be** many people who still remember the old railway station.
sentences.translation: Eski vokzalni hali ham eslaydigan odamlar **ko'p bo'lmasa kerak**.

sentences.text: Why is the road closed? — **There must have been** an accident.
sentences.translation: Nega yo'l yopiq? — Avariya **bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: I'm sure **there will be** plenty of food, so don't bring anything.
sentences.translation: Ovqat **ko'p bo'lishiga** ishonaman, hech narsa olib kelmang.

sentences.text: If we leave at five, **there shouldn't be** any traffic on the ring road.
sentences.translation: Soat beshda chiqsak, aylanma yo'lda tirbandlik **bo'lmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: **Could there be** a connection between the two robberies?
sentences.translation: Ikki o'g'rilik o'rtasida bog'liqlik **bo'lishi mumkinmi**?

sentences.text: Madina says **there might have been** a misunderstanding with the hotel.
sentences.translation: Madinaning aytishicha, mehmonxona bilan tushunmovchilik **bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Somewhere in this city **there must be** a shop that sells proper English tea!
sentences.translation: Bu shaharning biror joyida haqiqiy ingliz choyini sotadigan do'kon **bo'lishi kerak-ku**!

examples.title: **there used to be**, **there's bound to be**
examples.description: there boshqa fe'l qoliplari bilan: there used to be (ilgari bor edi), there's going to be, there seems / appears to be (borga o'xshaydi), there's bound / sure / likely to be.

sentences.text: **There used to be** a cinema on this corner, but it closed years ago.
sentences.translation: Bu burchakda **ilgari** kinoteatr **bor edi**, lekin u yillar oldin yopilgan.

sentences.text: The forecast says **there's going to be** heavy snow in the mountains tonight.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra, bugun kechasi tog'larda kuchli qor **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: **There seems to be** something wrong with the printer — it won't turn on.
sentences.translation: Printerda **nimadir nosoz bo'lsa kerak** — yoqilmayapti.

sentences.text: Book early, because **there's bound to be** a lot of demand for the concert.
sentences.translation: Erta bron qiling, chunki konsertga talab **albatta katta bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Experts say **there are likely to be** more storms like this in the future.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislarning aytishicha, kelajakda bunday bo'ronlar **ko'proq bo'lishi ehtimoli katta**.

sentences.text: Is **there going to be** a meeting about the new timetable?
sentences.translation: Yangi jadval bo'yicha majlis **bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: When my parents were young, **there didn't use to be** so many cars in the city.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam yoshligida shaharda bunchalik ko'p mashina **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: **There appears to be** a problem with your visa, so please wait here.
sentences.translation: Vizangizda muammo **borga o'xshaydi**, iltimos, shu yerda kuting.

sentences.text: Wherever you go in Samarkand, **there's sure to be** someone offering you tea.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda qayerga bormang, sizga choy taklif qiladigan kimdir **albatta topiladi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry about the flight — **there's unlikely to be** a delay in this weather.
sentences.translation: Reys haqida xavotir olmang — bunday havoda kechikish **bo'lishi dargumon**.

examples.title: **there's no need to**, **there's no point in**
examples.description: Inkor qoliplar: there's no need to ... (hojat yo'q), there's no point in -ing (foydasi yo'q, → 63-dars), there's nowhere / nothing to ..., there isn't enough time ...

sentences.text: **There's no need to** book a table — the restaurant is never full on Mondays.
sentences.translation: Stol band qilishga **hojat yo'q** — dushanba kunlari restoran hech qachon to'lmaydi.

sentences.text: **There's no point in** arguing with him; he never changes his mind.
sentences.translation: U bilan bahslashishdan **foyda yo'q**; u hech qachon fikridan qaytmaydi.

sentences.text: In the old town **there's nowhere to** park, so we'd better take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Eski shaharda mashina qo'yishga **joy yo'q**, yaxshisi taksiga o'tiraylik.

sentences.text: We've missed the last bus, and **there's nothing** we can do about it now.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi avtobusdan qolib ketdik, endi bu borada qila oladigan **hech narsamiz yo'q**.

sentences.text: **There isn't enough time** to visit both Bukhara and Khiva this week.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta Buxoroga ham, Xivaga ham borishga **vaqt yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: Is **there any point in** applying if I haven't got the right degree?
sentences.translation: Kerakli diplomim bo'lmasa, hujjat topshirishning **foydasi bormi**?

sentences.text: You look exhausted — **there's no reason** why you can't take a day off.
sentences.translation: Juda charchagan ko'rinasiz — dam olish kuni olmasligingizga hech qanday **sabab yo'q**.

sentences.text: Thank you, but **there was no need for** you to wait for me.
sentences.translation: Rahmat, lekin meni kutishingizga **hojat yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Hurry up! **There's hardly any** milk left, and the shop closes in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Tezroq! Sut deyarli **qolmadi**, do'kon esa o'n daqiqadan keyin yopiladi.

sentences.text: Since the new bridge opened, **there's no longer any** need to take the ferry.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik ochilganidan beri parom bilan o'tishga endi **hojat qolmadi**.

examples.title: **it**: distance, time and weather
examples.description: it — masofa, vaqt, ob-havo va vaziyat haqida bo'sh ega: it's a long way, it takes two hours, it's getting late. O'zbekchada bunday gaplarda ega yo'q.

sentences.text: From Tashkent to Nukus **it's** a long way, so most people fly.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Nukusgacha yo'l **uzoq**, shuning uchun ko'pchilik samolyotda uchadi.

sentences.text: How long does **it take** to get to the airport from here?
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan aeroportgacha borishga qancha vaqt **ketadi**?

sentences.text: **It's** getting late — we should think about going home.
sentences.translation: Kech **bo'lib qoldi** — uyga qaytish haqida o'ylashimiz kerak.

sentences.text: On the beach **it was** so windy that we couldn't open the umbrella.
sentences.translation: Plyajda shunchalik kuchli shamol **bor edi**ki, soyabonni ocha olmadik.

sentences.text: Is **it** far to the old town, or can we walk? — **It's** about fifteen minutes on foot.
sentences.translation: Eski shahargacha **uzoqmi** yoki piyoda borsa bo'ladimi? — Piyoda o'n besh daqiqacha **yo'l**.

sentences.text: Near the stadium **it took** us nearly an hour to find a parking space.
sentences.translation: Stadion yaqinidan mashina qo'yish joyi topishimizga qariyb bir soat **ketdi**.

sentences.text: Can you believe **it's** ten years since we last met? You haven't changed at all.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi marta ko'rishganimizga o'n yil **bo'lganiga** ishonasizmi? Siz umuman o'zgarmabsiz.

sentences.text: When **it's** this hot, nobody goes out before six in the evening.
sentences.translation: Havo bunchalik **issiq bo'lganda** kechki oltigacha hech kim tashqariga chiqmaydi.

sentences.text: **It's** a shame the museum is closed on Mondays — we'll have to come back.
sentences.translation: Muzey dushanba kunlari yopiq bo'lishi **achinarli** — yana kelishimizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: I like **it** here: **it's** quiet, the people are friendly and the food is amazing.
sentences.translation: Bu yer menga **yoqadi**: **tinch**, odamlari samimiy, taomlari esa ajoyib.

examples.title: **It's** hard **to** ..., **It's a pity that** ...
examples.description: it + sifat / ot + to-infinitiv yoki that-gap: It's difficult to..., It's a pity that..., It's no use / no good -ing, I find it hard to... «There is difficult» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: In London **it's** difficult **to** find a cheap flat near the centre.
sentences.translation: Londonda markazga yaqin arzon kvartira topish **qiyin**.

sentences.text: **It's a pity that** you missed the concert — it was fantastic.
sentences.translation: Konsertni o'tkazib yuborganingiz **afsus** — u ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: Honestly, **it's no use** complaining to the manager; he never does anything.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, menejerga shikoyat qilishdan **foyda yo'q**; u hech qachon hech narsa qilmaydi.

sentences.text: I **find it** hard to concentrate when people are talking on the phone.
sentences.translation: Odamlar telefonda gaplashayotganda diqqatimni jamlash menga **qiyin**.

sentences.text: **It** surprised everyone **that** Jasur resigned so suddenly.
sentences.translation: Jasurning to'satdan ishdan ketgani **hammani hayron qoldirdi**.

sentences.text: Is **it** safe **to** drink the tap water in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Toshkentda jo'mrak suvini ichish **xavfsizmi**?

sentences.text: If you're going to Khiva, **it's worth** taking the night train.
sentences.translation: Xivaga borayotgan bo'lsangiz, tungi poyezdga chiqishga **arziydi**.

sentences.text: Madina **made it** clear **that** she didn't want to move to another city.
sentences.translation: Madina boshqa shaharga ko'chishni xohlamasligini **aniq aytdi**.

sentences.text: Let's walk to the main road — **it's no good** waiting for a taxi here.
sentences.translation: Katta yo'lgacha piyoda boraylik — bu yerda taksi kutishdan **foyda yo'q**.

sentences.text: Wasn't **it** nice of Emma **to** bring us flowers?
sentences.translation: Emma bizga gul olib kelgani **qanchalik yoqimli** bo'ldi-a?

examples.title: **there** or **it**?
examples.description: Juftliklar bitta gapda: there — yangi narsa, mavjudlik («bor / yo'q»); it — baho, vaziyat, ma'lum narsa («qiyin», «afsus», «uzoq»).

sentences.text: **There's** a lot of traffic today, so **it'll** take longer to get to work.
sentences.translation: Bugun tirbandlik **ko'p**, shuning uchun ishga yetib borish ko'proq vaqt **oladi**.

sentences.text: **It's** too far to walk, and **there aren't** any buses after ten.
sentences.translation: Piyoda borishga juda **uzoq**, soat o'ndan keyin esa avtobus **yo'q**.

sentences.text: I'd like to swim, but **it's** too cold and **there's** a strong wind.
sentences.translation: Suzgim keldi, lekin havo juda **sovuq** va kuchli shamol **bor**.

sentences.text: Was **there** anything interesting in the news? — Not really, **it** was all about the weather.
sentences.translation: Yangiliklarda qiziq narsa **bormidi**? — Unchalik emas, **hammasi** ob-havo haqida edi.

sentences.text: **It's** a pity **there** wasn't more time to look around the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Bozorni aylanishga ko'proq vaqt **bo'lmagani afsus**.

sentences.text: When **there's** a power cut, **it's** impossible to do any work.
sentences.translation: Elektr **o'chib qolganda** biror ish qilishning **iloji yo'q**.

sentences.text: Is **it** true that **there's** going to be a new metro line to the airport?
sentences.translation: Aeroportgacha yangi metro liniyasi **bo'lishi rostmi**?

sentences.text: **There's** no lift in our building, so **it's** hard work carrying the shopping upstairs.
sentences.translation: Binomizda lift **yo'q**, shuning uchun xaridlarni yuqoriga olib chiqish **og'ir**.

sentences.text: Although **it** was raining, **there** were hundreds of people at the festival.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **yog'ayotgan** bo'lsa ham, festivalda yuzlab odam **bor edi**.

sentences.text: **It** doesn't matter how many times I check — **there's** always a typo somewhere.
sentences.translation: Necha marta tekshirmay, **farqi yo'q** — biror joyda doim xato **chiqadi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: checking into a hotel in Bukhara
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: mehmon va administrator suhbati — there is / there will be / there's bound to be va it bilan vaziyat gaplari.

sentences.text: — Good evening. **There's** a reservation under the name Brown, for three nights.
sentences.translation: — Xayrli kech. Braun nomiga uch kechaga **bron bor**.

sentences.text: — Let me check... Yes, here **it** is. **It's** a double room on the second floor.
sentences.translation: — Hozir tekshiraman... Ha, mana **u**. Ikkinchi qavatdagi ikki kishilik **xona**.

sentences.text: — Great. **Is there** a lift? Our suitcases are really heavy.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Lift **bormi**? Chamadonlarimiz juda og'ir.

sentences.text: — I'm afraid **there isn't**, but **there's** a porter who can help you.
sentences.translation: — Afsuski, **yo'q**, lekin sizga yordam beradigan hammol **bor**.

sentences.text: — Fine. **Is it** far from here to the Ark? We'd like to walk there tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Bu yerdan Arkkacha **uzoqmi**? Ertaga piyoda bormoqchimiz.

sentences.text: — No, **it's** only ten minutes on foot, but **it** gets very hot after eleven.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, piyoda bor-yo'g'i o'n **daqiqa**, lekin soat o'n birdan keyin havo juda **isib ketadi**.

sentences.text: — Good to know. Will **there be** a lot of tourists at this time of year?
sentences.translation: — Bilganim yaxshi bo'ldi. Yilning bu paytida sayyohlar **ko'p bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: — **There are bound to be** a few groups, but **it** won't be too crowded.
sentences.translation: — Bir nechta guruh **albatta bo'ladi**, lekin unchalik gavjum **bo'lmaydi**.

sentences.text: — And **there's** free Wi-Fi in the room, isn't **there**?
sentences.translation: — Xonada bepul Wi-Fi **bor**, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: — Of course. If **there's** anything else you need, **it's** no trouble at all — just call reception.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Yana biror narsa **kerak bo'lsa**, hech qanday **qiyinchilik yo'q** — qabulxonaga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
